reason: The answer table's column-header row is printed 'Question | Expected answer | Marks' at the top of every page (y85.3) with a lower-case 'answer', which the furniture rule for header rows does not recognise. The automatic cut therefore carried the parts that end at a page foot (1(b)(v) p2, 1(c)(i) p3, 2(a)(ii) p5, 2(c)(i) p6) onto the next page's header row only (no marking content precedes the next key there); these are cut by hand to end at their page foot (y547.5, above the footer), and the header row on every page (p2-p7) is whited out as furniture.
